description: Combined migration: returns the Claude lane to BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0 and MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER=0. Migrates scripts/verified_task/command_runner.py (replaces shell=True with argv-list /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe /c invocation through intake.hardened_runner) and scripts/determinex_codeclash_agent.py (routes py_compile through intake.hardened_runner with workspace=state.codebase). Preserves CommandResult shape and adds a new stricter run_argv() API.
purpose: Rung 9 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. Seals the two safety findings surfaced by the rung-8 classification sweep. After this rung lands, the Claude lane is at the cleanest possible state for MODEL_ROUTER_LOCK_001 work to begin.

command_runner.py.approach: Replace shell=True invocation with argv-list invocation of the platform shell binary as the first argv element, routed through intake.hardened_runner.run. _shell_argv() helper returns ['/bin/sh', '-c', command] on POSIX and ['cmd.exe', '/c', command] on Windows.
command_runner.py.shell_semantics_preserved: Glob expansion (*.sh), pipes, redirects, &&, ||, and Windows cmd.exe idioms (if exist Makefile (...)) all continue to work because the shell binary is still the program — only the kwarg shell=True is removed.
command_runner.py.new_api: CommandRunner.run_argv(argv: list[str], *, cwd, timeout_seconds) — stricter path that takes argv directly, no shell wrapper

returncode_conventions.126: BLOCKED by hardened runner (new code; shell convention 'command found but not executable')
returncode_conventions.127: tool not found (new code; shell convention 'command not found')

determinex_codeclash_agent.py.approach: Replace raw subprocess.run for py_compile with intake.hardened_runner.run, passing workspace=state.codebase to bound execution to the arena workspace.

The CommandRunner shell-wrap path executes the command via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe /c — the inner shell can still spawn arbitrary child programs. The threat model is 'TaskSpec authors are Determinex-internal'; not a user-input boundary. Operator discipline required when adding new TaskSpec adapters.

Docker/network blocklist only checks the first argv element (the shell binary), not the contents of `-c <command>`. The hardened_runner's policy fires on the shell wrapper, not on commands nested inside it. Acceptable given the threat model; a follow-up rung could add shell-content scanning if needed.
Codeclash agent's py_compile uses a fixed 30s timeout. If arena codebases ever grow large, this may need to become configurable.
